name: holders_of
description: Name the individuals holding an individual in one of their fields, with the field and a summary of the holder's kind. An individual's meaning often lives in what holds it: a bare body may be the root of a Cup. Describing an individual already lists its holders, so use this for an individual you have not described.

handle.description: The individual's handle, exactly as a tool's answer gave it, such as 'Cup#1'.
